crossRefs.note: Elijah came near to all the people, and said, “How long will you waver between the two sides? If Yahweh is God, follow…
Micaiah said, “If you return at all in peace, Yahweh has not spoken by me.” He said, “Listen, all you people!”
Hear this, all you peoples. Listen, all you inhabitants of the world,
both low and high, rich and poor together.
Consider, you senseless among the people; you fools, when will you be wise?
He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.
Meanwhile, when a multitude of many thousands had gathered together, so much so that they trampled on each other, he…
He said to the multitudes also, “When you see a cloud rising from the west, immediately you say, ‘A shower is coming,’…
In the hearing of all the people, he said to his disciples,
You simple, understand prudence! You fools, be of an understanding heart!
He said, “Go, and tell this people, ‘You hear indeed, but don’t understand. You see indeed, but don’t perceive.’
Philip ran to him, and heard him reading Isaiah the prophet, and said, “Do you understand what you are reading?”

parallels.note: He summoned the multitude, and said to them, “Hear, and understand.

translations.web: He called all the multitude to himself, and said to them, “Hear me, all of you, and understand.
translations.bsb: Once again Jesus called the crowd to Him and said, “All of you, listen to Me and understand:
translations.kjv: And when he had called all the people unto him, he said unto them, Hearken unto me every one of you, and understand:
translations.asv: And he called to him the multitude again, and said unto them, Hear me all of you, and understand:
